subject: Aircraft carrier waits and movement/interaction on the user desktop

build.configuration: CMake Release, clang, SDL2 Tiles, sound, Lua Platform v1, Tracy enabled

host.hardware: AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, renoir, ACO), hardware accelerated

scene.original_world_integrity_method: All 48 SHA256 hashes equal the pre-test fixture; experiments use copied user directories.

protocol.input: Normal X11 key events addressed only to the verified game window PID; native replay log confirms exact key count and order.
startup_inputs: Return to acknowledge existing Lua notice
Z once to zoom from 8 to 4
protocol.sampling: perf record -m 64 -e cycles:u -F 397 --call-graph dwarf,32768 -t GAME_PID -o PREFIX.data -- sleep RECORD_SECONDS
protocol.stat: perf stat -x ; -e task-clock,cycles:u,instructions:u,cache-misses:u -p GAME_PID -o PREFIX.stat -- sleep COLLECTOR_SECONDS
protocol.record_window_seconds: Collector window minus 2 seconds; wait 48s, movement 43s.
protocol.analysis_window: Input start through final input acknowledgement plus 0.25 seconds; excludes startup and long idle collector tail.
protocol.functions: Cycle-period weighted inclusive caller groups; argument signatures stripped, overloaded variants grouped once per sampled stack.
acceptance_commands: python3 compare-latest-state.py INITIAL_WAIT_TRIAL PERF_ONLY_WAIT_TRIAL OUTPUT_JSON --world Damon
protocol.collector_mode: perf record plus stat concurrently; no Tracy capture during the accepted perf-only pair, and no export or build running during sampling.

cases.name: wait
cases.counter_scope: All process threads for the full collector window, including idle tail. Not comparable across workloads with different windows.

input_receipt_ms.meaning: controller launch and event receipt/queue delay, not frame or pure simulation completion

state_reader.method: active zzip footer entry, footer and payload XXH64 verified

cases.name: move
cases.counter_scope: All process threads for the full collector window, including idle tail. Not comparable across workloads with different windows.

input_receipt_ms.meaning: controller launch and event receipt/queue delay, not frame or pure simulation completion

state_reader.method: active zzip footer entry, footer and payload XXH64 verified

state_validation.read_method: Active zzip footer entry and both footer/payload XXH64 checksums; a first-frame scan may read historical data after an append save.
state_validation.different_world_files: Only character .sav.zzip and .pt; the .pt values exactly equal saved total_time_played.

profiling_tool_failure.attempt: Initial wait run with perf/stat and Tracy simultaneously, before the accepted perf-only wait repeat.
profiling_tool_failure.result: CSV export spins in FileRead decompression-ready wait; stopped the owned exporter. A bounded 15s targeted export also produced no CSV. No Tracy zone time accepted.
profiling_tool_failure.container_check: 5529 complete compressed blocks; all four Zstd streams decode without errors; final uncompressed block 51191 bytes.
profiling_tool_failure.next_diagnostic: Compare the same retained capture with a matching reference 0.14.1 reader; do not repeat gameplay solely to regenerate an unreadable trace.

evidence.reuse_reason: source and regression inputs unchanged; no C++ edit in this measurement batch

cached_native_regression.reason: No src/, tests/, Makefile or CMakeLists.txt changes since 82a67a868cd903e1b6ab76350770dd9c2a582f91. No new game build or broad suite required for measurement metadata.

assessment.finding: Tile and minimap call paths dominate active main-thread CPU cycle samples in this fullscreen zoom-4 fixture: about 80% in 220 waits and 85% in 80 move/interaction inputs.
assessment.multithreading_priority: Measure and separate immutable render preparation from ordered main-thread SDL submission before choosing a worker batch. Keep simulation mutation, Lua and SDL on their owning threads.
assessment.movement_note: 80 directional inputs include melee/blocked interactions; not 80 walked tiles. The save advances 7 game seconds at debug speed 1100, net +7 y tiles, and one submap-origin change.
limitations: This is a baseline, not a before/after optimization comparison or a universal workload ranking.
Inclusive function rows and call-path categories overlap; do not sum them.
Unresolved SDL/system/driver leaves remain included under identifiable native callers; no-sample functions are not established to have zero cost.
Sampling overhead and counter multiplexing are present; counter running fractions are retained.
Input receipt latency includes the controller and event queue, not completed frame or pure simulation time.
GPU timings, FPS, off-CPU blocking, cold-load exploration, multiplayer and other platforms are outside this baseline.
Tracy aggregate/frame/phase statistics were not accepted because the CSV reader failed.
